title: A paint protection film brand with three audiences and two channels still open gets at least three choices, lead_audience among them

profile.value: Paint protection film (PPF) for cars and superbikes
Owners of new luxury cars; superbike riders; dealerships that fit film before delivery
Instagram and YouTube channels exist; Facebook page dormant

facts.statement: Aztek Films fits self-healing paint protection film on cars and superbikes.
The studio is in Baner, Pune, and a second studio is in Andheri, Mumbai.
A full-car film fitting takes three days.
The film carries a 10-year manufacturer warranty.
Aztek Films supplies film to two car dealerships in Pune.

rules.text: Never say the film makes a car scratch-proof.
Do not name other film installers.

answers.question: What should marketing achieve in the next 90 days?
answers.answer: More enquiries from new car owners, and more dealership tie-ups.

answers.question: How much time and how many people do you have for content each week?
answers.answer: One person, about four hours a week.

rubric: ask is null and there are at least 3 choices, one per key. lead_audience is among them, and its options come from the three audiences in the profile (new luxury car owners, superbike riders, dealerships), each trade-off naming a gain and a cost. No option or trade-off invents a claim about the brand: a certification, a price, a figure or result, a place, a competitor's name, or a product or service outside the brand's line of business that the input does not name. Paraphrasing what the input names, general reasoning about what an option gains or costs, proposed channels, audiences, rhythms, themes and formats, and general words about the brand's customers are all fine. No option calls the film scratch-proof. If a posting_rhythm choice is given, its recommended option fits one person with about four hours a week. Exactly one option per choice is recommended.
